lines.text: Looking for work is a second job.
Job Search HQ keeps track of all of it.
Every job, every next step, on a board that saves to a spreadsheet you own.
It finds openings that fit you...
and writes your resume from your real experience. Nothing made up.
Applications go faster, with every answer ready to copy.
It drafts your follow-ups. You send them.
Practice interviews out loud, with a clock and a scorecard...
and take your prep with you.
Works in Claude or ChatGPT, in plain words. No coding.
Job Search HQ. Try it with sample data first.
